colors.secondary: Soft Sage (#81B29A) for online status and verified badges

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-t border-white/10) for bottom navigation and overlays. Never use muddy gray transparency. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header.
visual_enhancers.monetization: Use THE TRACING BEAM effect for Premium/Top Picks entry points. No blocky static banners.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, diffuse ambient shadows for floating buttons.

dating_page.concept: Fullscreen Immersive Swipe Interface. Solves 'too much at once' by focusing on ONE profile.
dating_page.card_container: h-[80vh] md:h-[85vh] w-full max-w-md mx-auto relative rounded-[32px] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
dating_page.image_treatment: object-cover full width and height. Overlays MUST be limited to a bottom gradient (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/40 to-transparent) to preserve photo visibility.
dating_page.controls: Floating glassmorphism action bar at bottom with large pill-shaped/circular buttons.

motion.interactions: Use framer-motion for smooth swipe gestures (drag='x').
motion.transitions: transition-transform duration-300 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-200. NO transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast via strong bottom gradients and text-shadow.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

groups.description: Group photo for Discovery/Top Picks preview

DatingApp.instruction: Root component holding the layout, bottom nav, and conditional rendering for Discover, Matches, etc. Use German UI text (Entdecken, Matches, Nachrichten).

SwipeCard.instruction: Massive full-screen card representing a single profile. Addresses the 'no photos' feedback by making the image cover 100% of the card area. Do not use generic Shadcn cards here; use raw divs for maximum visual control.

MatchActionButtons.instruction: Floating overlay situated directly below or bottom-integrated with the swipe card. Must include distinct buttons for Pass, Super Like, and Like.

PremiumTeaser.instruction: Replaces blocky monetization banners. Implement as a glowing, glassmorphic 'Likes You' bubble at the top of the Discover feed, keeping monetization contextual and elegant.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Write components in .js files (React + Tailwind). Do NOT use .tsx.
Do NOT apply global `transition: all`. Use specific transitions.
Do NOT use center alignment on the app container.
MUST use `data-testid` on all interactive elements.
You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot or brain etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Ensure UI labels are in German per user request ('da sieht so viel auf einmal...').
Dating Card images must be massive, taking up max available viewport space to address 'no photos' feedback.
Hide monetization behind contextual elements like glowing 'Likes You' borders, rather than intrusive static banners.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
